case_title: RAMSWAROOP AND ANOTHER v. STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH
aggravating_circumstances: Unlawful assembly, use of weapons, fatal injuries
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under Sections 148, 302, 452, 325 read with 149 of IPC
neutral_facts: The prosecution case was that the cows of the deceased had damaged the crops standing in the field of the accused, leading to a heated altercation. The accused formed an unlawful assembly and carried weapons, chased the deceased, and assaulted him, resulting in his death. The deceased's mother, who sustained injuries while trying to save her son, provided an eyewitness account. Medical evidence showed the injuries inflicted by the accused were sufficient to cause death. The deceased was taken to the hospital but died en route. The trial court convicted the accused under multiple sections of the IPC, and the High Court confirmed the conviction.
